item.title: Langflow OSS MCP stdio Environment-Variable Injection to Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-12940)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-12940. Status: Weaponized (upstream demonstrates end-to-end command execution with captured evidence; not re-executed during archival). Affects: Langflow OSS (langflow-ai/langflow), MCP stdio server registration and launcher. Tags: langflow, mcp, stdio, environment-variable-injection, shellopts, ps4, bash, command-injection, unauthenticated, rce, cwe-78.
